posts.text: ADHD is like sprinting with no map. But sometimes, you discover magic that way.
I didn’t start talking about ADHD because I had it all figured out
If it takes 2 minutes, do it now — before ADHD makes it a week-long task.
With ADHD, I don’t start when I should—I start when it’s almost too late. Relatable?
My ADHD brain thinks the internet is an amusement park. This hit.
ADHD in minority homes feels like breaking a family rule: admitting you’re struggling. Anyone else feel this?
